answer: A nebula of identities floats through the network; most are real, some are sybils. Each identity must cross a river of random audits to earn consensus weight. The river has a bridge toll: a bond of 30 POA locked for 15 epochs, non-transferable, bound to one identity. A rotating orchard of auditor nodes samples 10% of bonds per epoch and slashes fakes. An attacker running N fakes must keep all N bonds alive for the full 15-epoch vesting window while facing rising audit exposure. Cost grows linearly with N plus a compounding slash term.
